external_selection: First settled game per distinct registration ID in chronological order of the 32 archived v1 ladder games; six opponent identities; chosen without selecting score, deterministic prior to fitting.
roots: Use step 3+5k (up to 293) on both domains exactly as previous next-action calibration. Train only its 2 original maps. Held old four maps and all six external opponents after coefficient freeze.
single_model: Fixed published role temperature. Each worker role gets four fitted logits offsets for continuing, reversing, staying after motion, and staying after a stationary predecessor; lateral moves zero. New arrivals unadjusted. Mean one-hot cross entropy by map plus 0.02/2 squared weight penalty per role, bounds [-4,4]. Eight weights total.
decode: Common preregistered 16 natural native draws per root & method. Compare physical destinations with real next orders after joint decoding. Report all roots, per-role counts, rival recruitment consumes native budget, actual team equality and physical-event Brier.
qualification: Map-equal worker Brier strictly lower than both raw and published role-temp on original held and external; at least 3/4 and 4/6 groups improve vs role-temp; one-draw complete-team agreement cannot fall vs role-temp in either domain pooled across registered 16 draws. No match or candidate build in this experiment.
limits: Topologies and archived ladder matches are previously seen development data but held out of this fit; no formal exam.
